plays.desc_ko: 탑 쪽에서 TLAW가 Faker를 묶음(lock up). Faker는 세라프 실드로 버팀; 이후 서술은 마스킹.
plays.desc_en: TLAW locks up Faker (Orianna) top side, but he holds on with his Seraph's shield.
plays.quote: side lock up there on the Faker. He's ... tanking with the seraps as well, but

plays.desc_ko: Keria가 두 명에게 걸어 들어가 쫓아내고 Oner도 따라감. 카밀 궁극기가 시도되나 전술적 휩쓸기 둔화가 적중을 막았다는 묘사, Doran도 추격 합류. TLAW는 신비한 여정으로 빠져나감. 해설은 T1이 탑 쪽을 장악한다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Keria (Camille) walks into two enemies to chase them off with Oner and Doran joining; Hextech Ultimatum is attempted but Tactical Sweep's slow prevents it landing, and TLAW escapes through Magical Journey as T1 controls the top side.
plays.quote: on this Camille support. He's going to ... chase them off as Owner is also ... can walk into two people and play LIKE

plays.desc_ko: T1이 정글 침투로 Core를 발견. 기절은 빗나갔지만 Core가 잠시 묶이고, 스테이시스로 버틴 사이 T1 전원이 대응. Core는 즉시 점멸로 빠지고 T1은 TLAW의 스킬 쿨다운을 소모시킴.
plays.desc_en: T1 spots CoreJJ (Bard) while invading; the stun misses but he's briefly held and uses Stasis before Flashing away, with T1 burning TLAW's cooldowns.
plays.quote: But here comes the invade from ... T1 or spots them. Stun does not connect. ... is here to respond. Cora instantaneous

plays.desc_ko: Jose가 점멸로 벽을 넘어 바텀 쪽 T1 무리(Peyz, Faker, Keria)에게 3인 회오리(우콩 궁극기)를 적중시키고 Morgan이 궁극기로 연계. Morgan이 Quid 쪽으로 이어가고 Peyz의 Eclipse 반격. 해설은 'TLAW가 얻을 수 있는 최고의 이니시'였지만 T1이 이중 스테이시스로 버텼다고 평가. 이후 TLAW 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: Jose (Wukong) flashes over the wall to hit Peyz, Faker and Keria with Cyclone, followed by Morgan's (Yasuo) ultimate, as Peyz answers with Golden Eclipse. Casters call it TLAW's best possible engage, but T1 survives with double Stasis and TLAW retreats.
plays.quote: Flash over the ... THREEMAN IMMEDIATE CYCLE ... And that was about as good of an engage

plays.desc_ko: TLAW 진입을 버틴 뒤 Doran(메가 나르)이 제때 들어와 궁극기로 벽에 밀어붙이며 역전. Yan은 도망칠 곳이 없고 T1이 4킬, Keria가 5번째를 노림. Core가 포탈로 도주하지만 Keria가 선더드 스카이 회복으로 길게 추격해 에이스.
plays.desc_en: After surviving TLAW's engage, Doran (Gnar) arrives as Mega Gnar and slams enemies into the wall with GNAR!, leaving Yeon nowhere to run as T1 gets four kills; Keria (Camille) chases CoreJJ through the portal with Thundered Skies healing for the ace.
plays.quote: DORAN [screaming] THERE JUST IN TIME TO ... TURN THE PLAY ON. ... T1 take

plays.desc_ko: 에이스 진행 중 T1 나머지 인원이 바론을 노림. 해설은 정통 원거리 딜러 없이 바론을 마무리해야 하며, 얻으면 사거리 이점이 크다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: During the ace, the rest of T1 goes for Baron, needing to finish it without a traditional ADC but gaining a big range advantage if secured.
plays.quote: their sights on Baron ... finish this Baron without a traditional

plays.desc_ko: T1이 기지를 두드리는 상황에서 Doran이 진입해 콤보를 성공, Faker의 연계, Keria 다이브. Quid가 잠시 묶이고 원 안에서 버티며 하나를 잡고, Jose 합류, Morgan 궁극기. Oner 더블킬 후 Faker도 더블킬로 마무리.
plays.desc_en: As T1 sieges the base, Doran (Gnar) lands a combo with Faker's follow-up and Keria diving; Quid briefly holds on and gets one while Jose joins and Morgan ults, but Oner's double kill and Faker's double kill close it out.
plays.quote: knocking on the base soon to be knocking ... Doran looking TO GO IN. MANAGES TO MAKE ... finding one in the midst of the fight.

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 Doran과 Faker가 넥서스 포탑으로 진격해 게임 1을 마무리. Core도 쓰러질 듯하다는 언급.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, Doran (Gnar) and Faker (Orianna) push the Nexus turrets to close out Game 1, with CoreJJ also looking about to fall.
plays.quote: it's going to be Odor and Faker ... alone at the nexus towers in game number ... opening game of MSI and they take it.
